jobs.occupation: Business Data Analyst, Falcom, GN Group
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Business Data Analyst to join our Commercial Operations team under the Program Management team and help turn commercial data into reliable, actionable insights for the business.

**Built on a proud legacy of more than 155 years of audio and technical solutions, FalCom delivers high-quality tactical communication systems, such as headsets, intercom systems, cables and connectors, sold to military and public safety users worldwide.

The role as Business Data Analyst is for someone who enjoys creating structure by building and maintaining data from HighStage, Excel and other business applications and is not always organized in the same way. You will not be expected to simply maintain existing reports, we are looking for someone who can build the structure behind them, challenge the data when something does not make sense, and continuously improve how we collect and organize information.

**The team you will be joining

**You will be based in our HQ in Ballerup and report to the Head of Program Management. You are expected to work independently, take ownership, and find motivation in contributing to the whole business. For our team to succeed we rely on trust, collaboration, and a positive, solution‑oriented mindset.

The role offers opportunities to grow. Over time, we expect you to take increasing ownership of our programs and sales data and help define how we use data across the business.

**Your Responsibilities

**You will work closely with Program Management, Sales and Operations to:

• Consolidate and analyse large datasets from HighStage, Excel and other business applications.

• Create structured datasets and identify fragmented, inconsistent or incomplete data inputs.

• Translate sales pipeline and program data into useful input for operational planning, forecasting and decision-making.

• Identify gaps and inconsistencies in our data and develop practical ways of improving data quality.

• Develop reporting and dashboards that create transparency across programs, opportunities, demand and deliveries.

• Work with stakeholders to understand what information they need and translate this into meaningful data and reporting.

• Support the development of our data structures as our systems and business processes evolve.

• Explore how AI and automation can improve the way we collect, structure, analyse and use business data.

**What We Are Looking For

**You probably have 2-5 years of relevant experience from a role within business analysis, data analysis, commercial operations, supply chain, or a similar field.

**We Expect That You

**

• Are highly skilled in Excel and comfortable working with large datasets.

• Have strong analytical skills and a structured approach to problem-solving.

• Can combine data from different sources and turn it into something useful for the business.

• Understand that good analysis requires both understanding the data and understanding the business behind it.

• Can communicate complex information in a simple and understandable way.

• Are fluent in written and spoken English.

Experience with tools such as Power BI, Power Query, SQL, Microsoft Dynamics 365 or similar platforms is an advantage, but not a requirement.

**Other Requirements For The Role

**Interest in AI is important. Hands-on experience using AI for analysis, automation or business processes is an advantage, but we are equally interested in someone who is curious and motivated to develop these capabilities.

Background check. Please note that all FalCom employees will be subject to a background check and must maintain a clean record throughout employment.

**We encourage you to apply

**Even if you don’t match all the above-mentioned skills, we welcome your application if you think you have transferable skills. We highly value a mindset and motivation that align with our core values, to not only ensure growth for you, but for your team and the wider GN organization as well.

**We are focused on an inclusive recruitment process

**All applicants will receive equal consideration for employment, which is why we encourage you to submit your CV without a photo.

Should you have any special requirements for the interview, please let the Hiring Manager know upon accepting the invitation to a potential first interview.

**How to apply?

**Use the ‘APPLY’ link no later than 27 November 2026. We review applications on an ongoing basis and will close the position once the right candidate is found, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

On a time crunch? Feel free to only submit your up-to-date CV, including a few sentences outlining your motivation for applying – quick and easy.

**Join us in bringing people closer

**FalCom is built on GN Group’s foundation, with 150+ years of innovation, as an established provider of intelligent audio solutions. Inspired by people and motivated by innovation, GN delivers technology that enhances hearing and sight. We enable people to overcome real-life problems, improve communication and collaboration for businesses, gamers, and tactical units.

GN Store Nord A/S has entered into a definitive agreement for the sale of GN’s Hearing business to Amplifon S.p.A. to create a global leader in audiology. For GN Group, this creates an opportunity to expand our position in the large audio and video peripherals markets. Read more about the announcement here.

**We hope you will join us on this journey and look forward to receiving your application.

Do you want to build and own the data pipelines that the rest of the business depends on? Then we have a skilled and ambitious team who would love to meet you!

Continia develops add-on solutions for Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central. Our solutions for accounts payable automation, e-documents, expense management and bank integration help more than 22,000 customers worldwide automate everyday finance processes, delivered through a global network of more than 2,200 reselling partners.

We are looking for a Data Engineer to join our Data & Reporting department. The department is responsible for business intelligence, integrations, and the machine learning and AI that run in production across the company.

You will be joining a small experienced team with different responsibilities on our platform, all owning a part of the setup.

About your role

Your focus will be on building and orchestrating data pipelines in Azure Data Factory and Databricks.

You will:

• Build, orchestrate and maintain data pipelines in Azure Data Factory and Databricks

• Ingest data from a broad range of source systems and land it reliably in our Data Lakehouse

• Write the SQL and Spark transformations that turn raw data into trusted, documented datasets

• Monitor, troubleshoot and improve pipelines already running in production

• Take ownership of data quality, lineage and documentation for the pipelines you build

• Work with the platform around the pipelines, including Unity Catalog, Event Hubs and Service Bus

• Collaborate with the colleagues who build our reporting and ML solutions on top of your data

You will work independently on your own tasks, with close sparring from experienced colleagues.

About you

SQL is your native language. It is the tool you reach for first, and you read, write and reason about it without thinking twice. You also:

• Have hands-on experience with Azure Data Factory, Databricks or similar pipeline and orchestration tools

• Know Python well enough to read, understand and modify code with confidence. You do not need to write it effortlessly

• Have worked with Spark or are keen to learn it

• Understand what Power BI and message-based technologies such as Service Bus are used for

• Work in a structured way, take ownership of what you build and are eager to learn

• Communicate comfortably in English. Danish is a plus but not a requirement

How we work with AI

Many of us use AI every day, and it is up to each person how much they use it. But we do not vibe-code our way into production. Code that goes live is code we understand, review and stand behind, and it meets our deployment standards like everything else. That is exactly why we need someone who can read and reason about code themselves instead of relying on a tool to do it for them.

What we offer

• Real pipelines in production from early on, with experienced colleagues to spar with

• A modern Azure data platform where you can influence how it develops

• A culture based on trust, responsibility and collaboration, where your ideas are taken seriously

• Opportunities for professional growth and learning

• A strong social environment where we celebrate successes and have fun together

• Work at the intersection of technology and business, with an impact you can see

The position is full-time with expected start in February. You will be based at our Aalborg office at Stigsborgvej 60, 9400 Nørresundby.

We work in a hybrid setup and are typically in the office three to four days a week, so fully remote work is not possible.

Ready to apply?

Send us your application and CV no later than 1 December. We review applications continuously and will reach out to candidates who match our needs.

Continia is committed to an inclusive recruitment process and equal opportunities for all applicants with a valid residence and/or work permit.

We look forward to hearing from you.

About Continia

At Continia, we value diversity and encourage authenticity. We are team players who respect each other's thoughts and ideas, and we expect everyone to take ownership of their work. We focus on personal and professional development to grow internally within our organization.

In our day-to-day work, we are pragmatic and result-oriented, and we aim to stay entrepreneurial by keeping things simple and focusing on our employees. We celebrate our wins and releases and aim to have one major event each year where all employees meet up in one place.

We recognize that time is what matters most. Continia solutions give customers more time every day to work and live. That's why "It's About Time" is our motto.

Ready to deliver high-impact projects that shape Pandora’s retail experience?

_As a Senior Specialist, Project Management, you’ll play a key role in driving strategic initiatives within Pandora’s Store Creative & Design team. Based at our Copenhagen HQ, this role offers a unique opportunity to combine analytical thinking with creative vision, ensuring projects are delivered with excellence and enable markets to execute flawlessly.

**Strategy meets execution and collaboration

**In this role, you will support the successful delivery of high-impact projects and strategic workstreams that require close cross-functional collaboration. You’ll work alongside the Senior Manager to define and execute SC&D’s strategic priorities, ensuring best-in-class project management practices across the organization. From developing tools and trackers to preparing business cases and high-quality presentations, you’ll help maintain clarity and alignment at every stage.

You’ll also build strong partnerships across Marketing, Retail Excellence, Supply Chain, and global market teams, acting as a trusted advisor and key point of escalation. This is an exciting opportunity to influence Pandora’s global retail strategy and contribute to creating memorable brand environments for our customers.

**Your Key Responsibilities Will Include

**

• Driving and supporting projects and strategic workstreams from kick-off to implementation and testing

• Defining project scope and plans in collaboration with functional experts and stakeholders

• Preparing business cases to evaluate benefits, costs, and risks of alternative options

• Facilitating cross-functional collaboration and problem-solving to meet deadlines

• Delivering regular updates to senior stakeholders, including key findings and recommendations

• Maintaining a full overview of SC&D projects and status trackers for clear communication

• Creating high-quality presentations for SC&D leadership and other stakeholders

• Establishing and role-modelling best-in-class project management practices

• Building strong relationships across global and market teams to ensure alignment

**To Succeed In This Role, You’ll Bring

**

• A Master’s or Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Strategy, Finance, Economics, or related field

• 3–5 years of experience in strategic project management within Marketing, Retail, Consulting, or Business Development

• Proven ability to manage complex projects with strategic importance

• Strong analytical skills and experience creating business cases

• Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to simplify complex topics

• Experience engaging with senior stakeholders and facilitating meetings independently

• Background in jewellery, retail, fashion, or FMCG is a plus

• Experience working in a global organization

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office, with advanced PowerPoint and Excel skills

• Fluent in Business English

**Your new team

**You’ll join Pandora’s Store Creative & Design team, a creative and strategic group within Global Marketing dedicated to designing desirable brand environments and delivering exceptional customer experiences. From our Copenhagen HQ, we collaborate across functions and markets to bring Pandora’s vision to life.

**Additional Information

**Global career band: 5A

Did we get your attention?    If you see yourself in the position and would like to become a part of Pandora’s future, please do not hesitate to apply by attaching your CV and portfolio. We look forward to hearing from you!

We process applications on a continuous basis, which is why we encourage you to send your application as soon as possible.

You can also read more about Pandora on our corporate site www.pandoragroup.com.

Icing on the cake    You will be working out of our beautiful Head Office in Copenhagen V, established in 2016 and designed to unite and inspire our teams. Besides our beautiful interior design we are also proud of our LEED Gold Certification for Energy and Environmental Design. This means that we use as few natural resources as possible and that we use them with respect. The result is a professional and dynamic space that is unique, comfortable and inspirational – and delivers a true Pandora experience to anyone who works here or comes to visit.

**About Pandora

**Pandora is the world's largest jewellery brand, specialising in the design, crafting, and marketing of accessible luxury jewellery made from high-quality materials. Each piece is created to inspire self-expression, allowing people to share their stories and passions through meaningful jewellery. Pandora jewellery is sold in more than 100 countries through 7,000 points of sale, including more than 2,800 concept stores.

Headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark, Pandora employs around 39,000 people worldwide and crafts its jewellery with 100% recycled silver and gold. Pandora is committed to leadership in sustainability and has set out to halve greenhouse gas emissions across its value chain by 2030. Pandora is listed on the Nasdaq Copenhagen stock exchange and generated revenue of DKK 32.5 billion in 2025.

jobs.occupation: AI Innovation Engineer at Novo Nordisk Engineering
jobs.description:
If you’re energised by creating impactful AI solutions and thrive on curiosity, collaboration and rapid experimentation, we’d love to hear from you!

**Who We Are

**We are a leading pharma engineering company shaping the future of API pharma engineering globally. Leveraging the expertise of 2,000+ employees across Denmark, India, and the US, we design, build and optimise pharmaceutical manufacturing facilities that are essential to the health and well-being of patients everywhere.

Our success is driven by passion, innovation, and collaboration — with our customers and across our teams and disciplines. If you share our dedication to a noble cause and our passion for API pharma engineering, then NNE is the place for you.

**About The Role

**We are looking for an AI Innovation Engineer to join the IT Development and Data team in Global IT, our central IT organization. You will be part of the team’s AI engineering capability, with a strong focus on rapid experimentation and exploring how AI can solve real business problems. You will work closely with business stakeholders, subject-matter experts and AI Partners to explore opportunities and quickly test what works.

In this role, your technical creativity and hands-on skills will be key to experiment with ideas, assess their feasibility and potential value and help promising concepts to move forward. Your work may span AI, automation, analytics, data and integration, depending on the problem at hand.

You will be expected to learn quickly, navigate ambiguity and find pragmatic ways to solve operational challenges, taking ideas from initial exploration towards solutions that can create value for the business.

Location Virum

Experience 2 - 5 Years

Department Global IT

**How You Might Spend Your Days

**As an AI Innovation Engineer you’ll be:

• Collaborating with AI Partners, engineering specialists, and business stakeholders to understand challenges, explore workflows, and identify where AI can create meaningful value.

• Rapidly experimenting with, building and testing AI-enabled solutions using approved development tools and platforms, and helping successful ideas mature and scale where relevant.

• Translating business needs into practical technical approaches and assessing feasibility, data readiness, implementation complexity, security and other relevant risks.

• Connecting models, data, systems and workflows to quickly test ideas, learn from users and iterate based on feedback and observed results.

• Capturing and sharing technical learnings, reusable components and successful approaches, and communicating technical options and trade-offs clearly to both technical and non-technical audience.

**Who You Are

**We care about who you are as a person. In the end, how you work, and your energy is what impacts the results we achieve as a team. As a person, you are:

• Curious and practical, with the confidence to explore possibilities while staying focused on solving a real user or business problem.

• Comfortable moving between conversations with stakeholders and hands-on development, and able to turn ambiguity into a testable next step.

• Collaborative and respectful of different professional, individual, and cultural perspectives.

• Open about uncertainty, trade-offs, and risks, and willing to seek input when a decision requires specialist knowledge.

• Motivated by continuous learning, experimentation and sharing knowledge that helps others move faster.

**What You Bring To The Role

**In all positions, there are some things that are preferred, and others, a bonus. If you do not meet all the qualifications listed below, you are welcome to offer alternative experience that you think would be valuable in this role:

• A bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, software engineering, data science, information technology, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

• Approximately 2–5 years of experience developing software, automations, analytics, data, or AI-enabled solutions.

• Hands-on experience with Python, APIs, integrations, and data. Knowledge of AI solution patterns (MCP, RAG, tool calling, agentic AI) and platforms such as Azure AI, Power Platform, or Microsoft Fabric is an advantage.

• Solid understanding of AI models, their capabilities and limitations, and how they influence solution design.

• AI-first mindset, using AI-assisted development to rapidly explore, build, test, and refine solutions.

• Experience working directly with business and technical stakeholders to understand problems, explore options and translate needs into practical technical approaches

**Life at NNE

**NNE is short for Novo Nordisk Engineering. And for all of us who work here, NNE means so much more.

At NNE, you become part of a vibrant, project-based environment built on close day-to-day collaboration. The role is therefore primarily on-site, with physical presence at the workplace expected five days a week. Limited flexibility for occasional remote work may be accommodated in line with business needs.

We are, at our core, a people business and, as such, committed to continuously developing our people and the way we work together. We do not expect you to know it all from day one, and we truly believe a great start makes a real difference. We therefore welcome new colleagues with our award-nominated onboarding programme, supported by a range of in-house talent and development initiatives designed to support your long-term growth.

You can read more about the benefits we offer **here .

****Did we spark your curiosity? If you’re ready to join our passion, let’s hear from you.

****Deadline of application is 1st December 2026

**Questions before applying? Send us a quick text to arrange a convenient time to chat. Contact Ivanna Jurkiv Ditlevsen at +45 3077 4721.

**Please note:

**

• We only accept applications submitted through our online recruitment system

• You do not need to attach a cover letter, but please include a few sentences about why you are applying in your resume or CV

• We invite to interviews on a running basis.

**Fair hiring:

**At NNE, we are committed to an inclusive recruitment process and equal opportunities for all job applicants. To maintain fairness, we request that you refrain from including a personal photo in your CV.

**Still searching for the right opportunity?

**If this position isn’t quite what you're looking for, but you know someone who would excel in this role, please share this job post. And don’t forget to explore our other exciting opportunities — your future role at NNE might be just around the corner! Visit our Career Site

jobs.occupation: Assistant Professors in Electronic Systems (with the possibility of tenure-track)
jobs.description:
At the Technical Faculty of IT and Design, Department of Electronic Systems, one or more positions as Assistant Professor in Electronic Systems are open for appointments from June 1, 2027, or soon after. The positions are full-time and available for a period of 4 years (with the possibility of tenure-track).

Who we are
In electronic engineering, Aalborg University is known worldwide for its high academic quality and societal impact. The Department of Electronic Systems employs more than 200 people, of which about 90 are PhD students, and about 40 % of all employees are internationals. In total, it has more than 700 students in its BSc and MSc programs, which are based on AAU's problem-based learning model.

The department leverages its unique research infrastructure and lab facilities to conduct world-leading fundamental and applied research within one or more of the following areas: communication, networks, control systems, AI, sound, computing, cyber security, quantum technology, and robotics. The department plays an active role in transferring inventions and results into applications in close collaboration with industrial partners worldwide.

The department places significant emphasis on supporting early career researchers and provides comprehensive career and personal development programmes, specifically designed to assist individual academics in achieving their professional objectives.

You can read more about the department at www.es.aau.dk.

Your profile and work tasks
We seek to appoint one or more Assistant Professors (with the possibility of Tenure-Track) to conduct research, teaching, and knowledge exchange, and to grow and develop the department's research activities within our subject fields.
The positions require internationally recognized research experience within one or more of the following areas:

• Communication
• Networks
• Antennas
• Control systems
• Sound
• Artifical intelligence
• Signal Processing
• Computing
• Quantum technology 
• Robotics

The main tasks and responsibilities include:
• developing a research profile and providing valuable contributions to science.
• providing research-based teaching and supervision within at least one subject area.
• participating in grant application activities
• coordinating own projects and contributing to an active academic environment.

Your competencies
You have an interest in collaborating with external partners and experience from participating in grant applications. You have also contributed to workplace well-being, collaboration, equal treatment, diversity, and a good working environment.
Selected candidates should demonstrate development potential in science and have peer-reviewed publications in recognized journals and books or anthologies. Under the leadership of others, you can plan and carry out individual teaching and supervision activities with a focus on the students' learning.

Qualification requirements
Applicants must have academic qualifications at PhD level. The potential of each applicant will be emphasized in the overall assessment

Tenure Track

When appointing tenure track assistant professors, Aalborg University also place particular emphasis on: 

• The candidate can demonstrate a high degree of autonomy in their previous education and employment path
• The candidate shows considerable potential and is among the best in their field
• The candidate has academic experience from several universities and/or research institutions and preferably international experience
• The candidate is a skilled communicator
• The candidate writes and speaks English at the academic level
• The candidate is expected to meet the criteria for permanent employment as an associate professor at Aalborg University at the end of the tenure track process
Assessment in connection with transfer to associate professorship
The assessment in connection with transition to tenure as an associate professor normally takes place in the final six months of the tenure track assistant professors’ employment. However, the employee may request that an assessment take place at an earlier time in the first four years. If this assessment finds that the employee is not academically qualified, they may request another assessment within the final six months of their period of employment. A maximum of two assessments may take place. 

The assessment, on transition to the associate professorship, will as a minimum, emphasize the following qualifications in relation to the scientific subject area of the tenure track assistant professorship: 

• Research qualifications equivalent to the level that can be achieved on the basis of satisfactorily completed employment as tenure track assistant professor.
• Documented scientific production at international level. Assessment will be based on up to ten selected publications selected by the employee.
• Documentation of pedagogical supervision and upgrading of qualifications, including a positive written assessment of teaching qualifications. The assessment will also be based on the employee's teaching portfolio.
• The level of contribution to an active academic environment as well as the ability to collaborate and build relationships.
• The level of experience with grant proposals and experience of communicating research to relevant stakeholders. 
If the tenure track assistant professor fails to request that their qualifications be assessed in the last year of their period of employment or if they are assessed as not academically qualified, the university must immediately initiate dismissal proceedings in accordance with the collective agreement rules. 

How to apply  
Your application must include the following: 

• Application, stating reasons for applying, qualifications in relation to the position, and intentions and visions for the position 
• Curriculum Vitae (CV) 
• Diplomas (master's degree diploma and PhD diploma) 
• List of publications, with an indication of the attached publications that you wish to be taken into account in the assessment. You may attach a maximum of five publications. 
• Documentation of teaching qualifications.Please see guidelines for teaching portfolio at The Technical Faculty of IT and Design. If this is not enclosed, the applicant must enclose the reasons for this .
• Dissemination qualifications, including participation on committees or boards, participation in organisations etc. 
• Additional qualifications in relation to the position 
• References/recommendations 
You can read more about the requirements for your application here.    

The application must be submitted via Aalborg University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aalborg University's website.  

Aalborg University wants to reflect the surrounding society and has diversity as a core value. Therefore, everyone, regardless of personal background and orientation, is encouraged to apply for the position. 

Aalborg University has a policy of parallel language use. The successful applicant is expected, with support from the university, to acquire Danish language skills over time and to be able to contribute to teaching in Danish within 2–5 years of employment, including grading and supervising students, at a level corresponding to the teaching undertaken.

Danish language courses will be offered as part of the employment.

Do you have any questions? 
If you have any questions about the position, you are more than welcome to contact us. You will find contact persons at the bottom of the jobpost.     

Further information 
Read more about our recruitment process here   

The appointment process at Aalborg University involves a shortlisting process. You can read more about the shortlisting and appointment process here.  

The hiring process at Aalborg University may include a risk assessment as a tool to identify potential risks associated with new hires, ensuring the safety, compliance, and integrity of the workplace. 

Salary and terms of employment  
The employment is in accordance with the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities and the Ministerial Order on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities. Furthermore, your terms of employment and salary are in accordance with the collective agreement between the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations and the state (AC collective agreement) and protocol on certain terms of employment of academic staff at universities.

You can find information about the salary and salary structure for the position in the Salary Overview for Recruitment - Scientific positions (VIP). Please refer to the introductory section of the page and the section entitled “Tenure track assistant professor/Tenure track researcher”.

Aalborg University - Knowledge for the world
Aalborg University is an international workplace with more than 3,700 employees. We offer real-world-oriented education and create world-class research results through collaboration between researchers, students, and public and private companies. This is how we achieve insights, new solutions to societal problems, and knowledge that changes the world. Our main campus is in Aalborg, but we also have campuses in Esbjerg and Copenhagen.

jobs.occupation: Global Process Owner, Procure to Pay, ERP Transformation
jobs.description:

• Owning the global P2P process design, standards, controls and performance

• Leading fit-to-standard process design with business experts, IT and our implementation partner

• Simplifying, standardizing and automating transactional flows to reduce manual work

**Suggested candidate profile

jobs.occupation: Data Analyst with Focus on Magnetic Navigation – DTU Space
jobs.description:
Join DTU Space on magnetic navigation! 

Are you passionate about unravelling the mysteries of Earth’s magnetic field? Do you have a keen eye for detail, a self-motivated attitude, and strong problem-solving skills? If so, we invite you to apply for a researcher position at DTU Space, where you'll contribute to cutting-edge applications of Earth’s magnetic field.

The job
In this position, you'll work at the forefront of geomagnetic research, collaborating with an interdisciplinary team to developing advanced methods for using the geomagnetic field for navigation.

Our expectations of you
We’re seeking someone who: 

• 
has knowledge of Earth's magnetic field and its use in Navigation

• 
is experienced in using MATLAB for scientific programming and data processing

• 
has prior experience with solving Inverse Problems, Kalman Filtering, and algorithms used for Navigation using Earth’s magnetic field

In addition to technical expertise, we value a team player who communicates effectively, thrives in a collaborative environment, and takes initiative. 

What we offer in return
At DTU Space, you’ll be part of a dynamic and supportive research community dedicated to pushing the boundaries of science and technology. Your work will play an integral role in advancing our understanding of geomagnetism and its applications.

If you meet the qualifications above and are excited about contributing to this fascinating field, we’d love to hear from you.

Salary and appointment terms
The appointment will be based on the collective agreement with the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations (AC). You are employed as an Academic Officer, Senior Officer, Senior Executive Officer. In addition, supplements can be negotiated in accordance with DTU’s salary structure for academic staff employed in technical-administrative positions at DTU (AC TAP): https://www.inside.dtu.dk/en/human-resources/during-employment/salary/salary-structures

The position is full-time in agreement with the candidate. The position is temporary, lasting until 31 December 2031. 

The starting date is 1 January 2027, or as mutually agreed.

Application and contact
Please submit your online application no later than 3 December 2026. Open the “Apply now” link, fill out the form and attach your motivated application, CV and exam certificates. 

If you would like additional information about the position, please contact professor and head of the division of Geomagnetism and Geospace Nils Olsen, email nio@space.dtu.dk.

Applications received after the deadline will not be considered.

All interested candidates irrespective of age, gender, disability, race, religion or ethnic background are encouraged to apply. As DTU works with research in critical technology, which is subject to special rules for security and export control, open-source background checks may be conducted on qualified candidates for the position.

About DTU Space
The DTU Space Institute has about 250 employees and is located in the greater Copenhagen area at the Lyngby Campus of the Technical University of Denmark. We link natural science closely with the development of new technology. DTU Space is involved in the full life cycle of space activities, including concept and design, construction and prototyping, calibration and validation, implementation and operations, data analysis, processing, dissemination, and applications, leading to new instruments and applications. With the specialised and refined technology available, we are getting more and more answers and further insight about the Earth and the universe surrounding us. We contribute to about 200 scientific publications a year.

DTU – For the benefit of society since 1829
DTU is one of Europe's leading elite technical universities. Through research and education at an international top level, we create solutions to the major societal challenges of our time and help secure Europe's global leadership in sustainable technological development. Since Hans Christian Ørsted founded DTU almost 200 years ago, our mission has remained the same: We develop and create value through the natural and technical sciences for the benefit of society. DTU has 13,800 students, 1,600 PhD students, and 6,500 employees. We work in an international environment and have an inclusive, stimulating, and informal work culture. DTU has campuses in all parts of Denmark and in Greenland and collaborates with the best universities around the world.

What if your commercial expertise could help shape the future of offshore wind and wildlife protection?

At DHI, we combine science, technology and engineering to address some of the world's most pressing environmental challenges.

We are looking for commercially minded Contract Managers to support the growth of MUSE's international project portfolio. In this role, you will work closely with project leaders and senior stakeholders to manage complex contractual arrangements, safeguard commercial interests and strengthen contractual governance across projects – all in support of successful project delivery.

This is an opportunity to apply your commercial and contractual expertise in a growing business at the intersection of offshore renewable energy, engineering and advanced technology, while helping build the foundations for scalable project delivery.

About DHI MUSE

DHI MUSE develops and delivers some of the world's most advanced bird and wildlife monitoring systems for offshore wind farms. Our solutions support developers, operators and regulators in understanding and mitigating environmental impacts while enabling the growth of renewable energy.

As a dedicated business unit within DHI's global organisation, MUSE brings together experts in offshore wind, engineering, software development, data analytics and ecology to deliver innovative monitoring solutions across international markets.

Responsibilities and Challenges

As Contract Manager, you will act as a trusted contractual and commercial advisor to Project Managers, the Project Portfolio Director and senior leadership within MUSE. You will support complex project-based engagements involving offshore wind developers, engineering teams, hardware and software suppliers, installation contractors and other project stakeholders.

You will provide contractual and commercial guidance throughout the project lifecycle, from tender and pre-award through execution, installation, commissioning, operational handover, operations and maintenance and project close-out. Applying sound professional judgement and commercial awareness, you will help protect project profitability, manage contractual risks and opportunities, and strengthen commercial outcomes across the portfolio.

The main responsibilities are to:

• Act as contractual and commercial advisor to Project Managers, the Project Portfolio Director and senior leadership across MUSE.

• Lead contractual assessments and provide expert advice on contract structures, obligations, risk allocation, remedies and commercial terms throughout the project lifecycle.

• Support tendering and proposal processes and support or lead contractual negotiations with clients, partners, suppliers and subcontractors, , in close collaboration with Project Managers and Legal.

• Manage contractual change and commercial opportunity processes, including variation orders, extensions of time, amendments and claims.

• Identify contractual risks, commercial opportunities and potential impacts arising from project changes, technical interfaces and delivery requirements.

• Support contractual and commercial management of suppliers, subcontractors and project delivery partners, including installation, commissioning and operations and maintenance obligations.

• Work closely with Project Managers to manage contractual obligations, delivery interfaces and commercial outcomes across complex technical projects.

• Ensure compliance with DHI policies, governance requirements and Levels of Authority.

• Collaborate with Legal, Finance, Technology & Innovation and project stakeholders on contractual matters and commercial decision-making.

• Contribute to the continuous improvement and development of MUSE contract standards, playbooks, templates and commercial project practices.

What We're Looking For

Required education, experience and capabilities

• 5–8+ years of relevant experience in contract management, commercial management or a similar project-based role, preferably within offshore wind or a comparable business area.

• Experience supporting complex technical projects, preferably within an international and multi-jurisdictional environment.

• A Master's or Bachelor's degree in Law, Business Administration, Engineering, Commercial Management or a related discipline.

• Strong understanding of contractual risk and opportunity management, claims, variations, amendments and commercial project drivers.

• Demonstrated ability to interpret contractual terms, assess commercial and operational implications and develop practical recommendations.

• Experience preparing contractual correspondence, managing notice requirements and maintaining clear records to support variations, claims and contractual compliance.

• Experience advising Project Managers and senior stakeholders on contractual matters and supporting decisions within delegated authority.

• Strong negotiation skills and confidence in client-facing contractual and commercial discussions.

• Experience working with project delivery teams, suppliers, subcontractors and other external stakeholders. Strong English communication skills, both written and verbal.

• Sound professional judgement, with the ability to work independently, balance competing project priorities and communicate contractual issues clearly to non-legal stakeholders.

Additional experience and strengths, contributing to success in this role

• Experience within offshore wind, offshore energy, engineering, IT and technology, infrastructure, environmental consulting or other complex project-driven industries.

• Experience with EPC, EPIC or EPCI delivery models, or other complex engineering and technology project contracts.

• Exposure to hardware and software integrated systems, installation, commissioning or operational delivery projects.

• Familiarity with contractual requirements associated with system integration, testing, commissioning, installation, maintenance and customer acceptance.

• A background in mechanical engineering or a strong understanding of technology development and delivery, including software, networking, hardware or engineering systems.

• Experience identifying gaps between client commitments and supplier or subcontractor obligations, and aligning relevant requirements across the contractual chain.

• Familiarity with international contractual frameworks and commercial governance.

• Experience developing or improving contract standards, templates or commercial management processes.

• Additional language capabilities supporting international client and stakeholder collaboration.

Why join DHI?

To work at DHI means being part of an organisation that is the global leader in solving the world's toughest challenges in water, environment and sustainability.

In this position, we offer you the opportunity to join a growing business unit with dedicated colleagues to:

• Support some of the most advanced wildlife monitoring projects in the offshore wind industry.

• Take on a visible commercial role influencing contractual outcomes and project profitability across an international portfolio.

• Collaborate with leading experts in offshore wind, engineering, software development, hardware systems and ecology.

• A highly international working environment with colleagues and clients across Europe and beyond.

• Professional and personal development opportunities within a global knowledge organisation.

• Flexible working arrangements.

• Help shape MUSE's commercial governance and contract management practices as the business continues to grow.

DHI is a global and independent company dedicated to working on challenges within the fields of water, environment and sustainability. Within these fields, we provide a wide range of advisory, digital advisory, research and water governance services as well as providing leading-edge MIKE technologies and products to the market. At DHI, we are constantly looking for passionate and talented people who are eager to join our team.

By joining DHI, you will not only become part of a dynamic and collaborative global team of experts; you will be empowered to innovate, engage and grow in your area of expertise. DHI is committed to disseminating our knowledge effectively and across our worldwide network of offices.

Location & Mobility

• The role is based at DHI offices in Denmark, with flexible working opportunities in accordance with DHI policy.

How to apply

Department of Biotech Research and Innovation Center
 Faculty of Health and Medical Sciences
 University of Copenhagen

  The University seeks to appoint an associate professor to the Department of Biotech Research and Innovation Center to commence on 1 April 2027.

  Information on the Department can be found at: https://sund.ku.dk/.

  Job description

  The associate professor has a strong track record in cryo-electron microscopy analysis of mitochondrial and herpesviral nucleic acid-protein complexes, including fundamental insights into mitochondrial protein synthesis and herpesvirus DNA replication. The candidate will further develop his/her research into a leading programme on mitochondrial and viral genome maintenance and gene expression to advance our mechanistic understanding of mitochondrial DNA replication, RNA quality control and DNA replication mechanisms across human herpesviruses. In his/her line of research, the candidate will combine biochemistry, biophysics, and single-particle cryo-EM to explore the mechanisms of action of the involved macromolecular complexes. Moreover, the candidate has demonstrated the ability to organize and teach practical cryo-EM-related courses. 

  The associate professor is expected to play an active role in strengthening BRIC's research and training environment, including supervision and mentoring of early-career researchers and engagement in BRIC's postdoctoral career development activities. The successful candidate will also contribute to academic leadership, committee work and other organizational activities within the department and faculty.

  The associate professor’s responsibilities will primarily consist of:

   	
• Research, including publication/academic dissemination 	
• Research-based teaching, including associated examination 	
• Research leadership, including guidance and supervision of researchers 	
• Obligation to share knowledge with the rest of society, including participation in public debate

 To be qualified for an associate professor position, you will be assessed according to these five overall criteria for recognising merit at the University of Copenhagen: Research, teaching, innovation & societal impact, organisational contribution and leadership. • Research qualifications at the level that can be achieved by satisfactorily completing a period of employment as an assistant professor/postdoc, but may also be obtained in other ways

 The position is permanent.
